subject: Where is my order #{order_id}?
body: Hi, I placed order #{order_id} {days} days ago and the tracking hasn't updated. Can you check where it is? Thanks, {name}

subject: Package marked delivered but not received
body: Tracking for order #{order_id} says delivered but there is nothing at my door or with my neighbours. Please help. - {name}

subject: Do you ship to my country?
body: Hello, I'd like to buy the {product} but I'm not sure if you ship internationally. What are the shipping times?

subject: Need order #{order_id} before Friday
body: I ordered the {product} as a gift (order #{order_id}) and the event is this Friday. Can you upgrade shipping? It's really important.

subject: Wrong address on order
body: I just noticed order #{order_id} is going to my old address. Can you change it before it ships?

subject: Return request for order #{order_id}
body: Hi, I'd like to return the {product} from order #{order_id}. It doesn't fit what I needed. How do I start a return?

subject: Refund not received yet
body: I returned order #{order_id} {days} days ago and still haven't seen the refund on my card. When will it arrive? {name}

subject: Charged for cancelled order
body: I cancelled order #{order_id} right after placing it but I was still charged. Please refund me as soon as possible.

subject: What is your return policy?
body: How many days do I have to return an item, and do I have to pay for return shipping?

subject: Partial refund request
body: One of the two items in order #{order_id} arrived late. Can I get a partial refund on shipping?

subject: {product} stopped working
body: The {product} I bought in order #{order_id} stopped working after {days} days. I'd like a replacement.

subject: Item arrived broken
body: My {product} (order #{order_id}) arrived cracked. Photos attached. This is really disappointing.

subject: Safety issue with {product}
body: The {product} from order #{order_id} got extremely hot and started smoking while charging. This is a safety hazard, please respond urgently.

subject: Wrong colour received
body: I ordered the {product} in black but got a different colour. Order #{order_id}. Can you exchange it?

subject: Question about {product} materials
body: Is the {product} made with recycled materials? Just curious before I buy another one.

subject: Can't log in
body: I keep getting 'invalid password' even after resetting it twice. Can you help me get back into my account? {name}

subject: Change my email address
body: I'd like to update the email address on my account. How do I do that?

subject: Someone else used my account
body: I got an order confirmation email for something I didn't buy. I think my account was hacked. Please lock it.

subject: Delete my account
body: Please delete my ShopFlow account and all my personal data.

subject: Unsubscribe from marketing emails
body: I keep getting promo emails even though I unsubscribed. Please remove me from the list.

subject: Charged twice
body: My card was charged twice for order #{order_id}. Please refund the duplicate charge.

subject: Payment keeps failing
body: My card keeps getting declined at checkout even though it works everywhere else. Is something wrong with your payment page?

subject: Do you accept PayPal?
body: Hi, can I pay with PayPal or only cards?

subject: Discount code not applied
body: I used a 10% discount code on order #{order_id} but the total didn't change. Can you refund the difference?

subject: Need an invoice with VAT
body: Could you send me a proper invoice with VAT details for order #{order_id}? I need it for my company.

subject: Partnership inquiry
body: Hi team, I run a small blog and would love to collaborate on a review of the {product}. Who should I contact?

subject: Great service!
body: Just wanted to say the {product} is fantastic and delivery was quick. Thanks! {name}

subject: Store opening hours
body: Do you have a physical store I can visit? What are your support hours?

subject: Product suggestion
body: Would love it if you stocked a larger version of the {product}.

subject: Bulk order for my office
body: We'd like to order 50 units of the {product} for our office. Do you offer business pricing?
